summary: Affiliate marketing website for fashion, jewelry, and luxury products under the account/name "aura&adorn".

existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website branded as "aura&adorn" focused on fashion, jewelry, and luxury products, including a Home page with brand headline, featured product sections, and clear navigation to categories.

Implement core affiliate browsing UX: category listing pages (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury) that show product cards (image, name, short description, price/price range optional), and a product details view with an external affiliate link button that opens in a new tab.
Create a simple admin-only UI for managing affiliate products (create/edit/delete) and wire it to the backend; use Internet Identity login to gate access to the admin area (no third-party auth).
Add required legal/affiliate transparency content: an "Affiliate Disclosure" page and a footer snippet indicating that the site may earn commissions from qualifying purchases.

Apply a coherent, fashion-luxury visual theme (not blue/purple) across the entire UI, including typography, spacing, and components; keep it consistent across Home, category pages, product views, and admin pages.
Render the generated brand images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the header/hero section and favicon/app icon as appropriate.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an affiliate marketing website for fashion, jewelry, and luxury products (brand/account: aura&adorn).

Add a basic product data model and persistence in the Motoko backend to support listing and viewing affiliate products, including fields: id, name, brand (optional), category (Fashion/Jewelry/Luxury), shortDescription, imageUrl (or stored image reference), affiliateUrl, and optional price/priceRange.

imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Luxury fashion brand wordmark logo, black on transparent background (aura-adorn-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png)
- Minimal monogram icon using letters A and A, black on transparent background (aura-adorn-monogram.dim_512x512.png)
- Elegant neutral hero background with subtle fabric/jewelry-inspired texture (aura-adorn-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
